reserveReview.reviewer: OpenAI Codex dated OUSG portfolio source review
reserveReview.rationale: The issuer-published September 11 portfolio contains seven positions totaling $339,173,302.42. The ondo-ousg adapter reads their dated amounts and stable document IDs directly, replacing the former single NAV envelope. BUIDL, BENJI and USDC are direct collateral dependencies; SWEEP and FYOXX are named untracked fund shares, while bank deposits and Other Assets remain separate. The exact Other Assets amount is $105,398.11 (about 0.0311%); sidecar weights are rounded to two decimals. Low legacy risk for named Treasury/liquidity fund shares follows the conservative tokenized-fund tier; bank deposits are medium and unresolved net receivables high. This is issuer-reported composition, not an independent audit or examination. Existing separate assurance/custody limitations remain unchanged. The published scope excludes OUSG limited partnership interests represented in non-tokenized book-entry form.
